declarations.evidence: Candidate formal-family erased-real region output and frame over the same independent input-memory formula. This earlier formal family adds an explicit L fp32 cast and an O destination cast after the source fp16 cast. It is retained for compatibility and now has 36 floating Q/O profiles. In particular, non-fp16 O is rejected by the unmodified native block store and must not be counted as Python source coverage. The new actualKernel removes both extra casts; full_flat_correctness and actual_source_equivalence cover that exact source. Direct-call integer/bool Q conversions, other runtime scale profiles, negative strides, native integer-width overflow, general native shape/target admission, host allocation validity, grid coverage, concurrent races and IEEE/device numerical behavior remain unverified. Independent comparator replay is pending. This scoped record is not full-port acceptance.

Dimension-general full exact-source real IO for both variants and causal modes. The unmodified Python body retains every source stride and unused parameter, Q-head base reuse for Q/K/V/O, K sequence stride for V, decimal 1.44269504, complete rounded-up unchecked KV loads, causal masking, fp16 Q/probability casts, fp32 accumulators and the exact L-then-O stores. ActualPrecision independently checks Q load and scaling precision and both stores, including fp64 multiplication before fp16 conversion. Native dot requires fp16 K/V, and the final block store requires fp16 O; the wrapper empty_like(Q) therefore requires fp16 Q/O. Six floating Q labels are modeled for direct calls with fp16 O. The unchanged-source offline Triton 3.7.1/sm90 probe checked 12 admitted cases and 10 expected block-store dtype rejections, at one block shape and fp32 scalar scale. This compile evidence does not establish GPU arithmetic or every launch configuration. The named IO includes actual source trace safety, successful finite-flat execution, both independent initial-memory attention outputs, and the complete raw-cell frame, including unallocated addresses and unrelated dtypes. The formula includes every physically loaded padded key. The reference scatters L then O in source lane order, preserving arbitrary output aliasing. Positive block step/source stop, bounds for every unchecked read/write, allocation disjointness/closure and zero undef are explicit. Real arithmetic erases floating casts. Finite witnesses discharge allocation/access premises for nonzero head ID, noncontiguous strides and SEQLEN=3/BLOCK_N=2; padding V=4 makes noncausal O=1 and L=2. Separate complete typed exact-source executions prove both variants and causal modes, causal O/L=0/0 with second-row L=1, noncausal O/L=1/2 and a raw frame outside all six store addresses. The real numerical backend uses actual dot/reduction/exp2/log2 and identity casts; it is nonvacuity evidence, not IEEE evidence. Direct-call integer/bool Q conversions, other runtime scale profiles, negative strides, native integer-width overflow, general native shape/target admission, host allocation validity, grid coverage, concurrent races and IEEE/device numerical behavior remain unverified. Independent comparator replay is pending. This scoped record is not full-port acceptance.
